description: Semantic/AST-based prevention rules for Neon Survivors (RSON) — Godot 4.6 GDScript

rules.name: Function defined but never called (dead code)
rules.message: Function is defined but never called or connected to a signal — dead code
rules.suggestion: Either call the function, connect it to a signal, or remove it. Add # @internal if intentionally public API.

rules.name: Signal declared but never emitted
rules.message: Signal is declared but never emitted — no code path fires this signal
rules.suggestion: Add signal_name.emit() at the appropriate state transition, or remove the declaration

rules.name: Node instantiated but never added to scene tree
rules.message: Node created with .new() but never add_child()ed — _ready() will never fire, signals won't connect
rules.suggestion: Call add_child(node) after instantiation, or instantiate via preload().instantiate() and add_child()

rules.name: Per-frame group query without caching
rules.message: get_nodes_in_group() called in _process/_physics_process — O(N) scene tree traversal every frame
rules.suggestion: Cache in _ready() and update via group signals, or use a singleton enemy registry

rules.name: Unreachable branch in stage-gated boss logic
rules.message: Boss attack branch is unreachable due to stage check condition — logic error in gating
rules.suggestion: Verify stage variable values and comparison operators; add test coverage for each stage

rules.name: Save function without encryption
rules.message: Save function writes plain-text JSON without encryption — game state is unprotected
rules.suggestion: Use FileAccess.open_encrypted_with_pass() or Marshalls.variant_to_base64() with a key

rules.name: Per-shot node allocation (PointLight2D, SceneTreeTimer)
rules.message: SceneTreeTimer or node allocated per-shot — causes GC pressure and visual flicker
rules.suggestion: Use object pooling for projectiles; pre-allocate PointLight2D instances and toggle visibility
